mps_portability_execution.interpretation: Four runs selected epoch zero and predicted every test patient as class 0; the fifth predicted one class-1 patient. Accuracy largely tracks each unstratified split's majority-class prevalence.
mps_portability_execution.post_execution_metadata_correction: The execution manifest incorrectly described class 0 as PD-only and class 1 as SD/PR/CR. The deposited and executed numeric labels were unchanged: class 0 is PD/SD and class 1 is PR/CR. Exact pre-correction inputs are preserved beside the results.

bounded_gaps: No release or tag identifies the exact commit used for the proceedings results.

The original pc_full.pkl, patient_list_full.pkl, and labels_full.npy serializations are unavailable, but their numerical and semantic contents are deterministically reconstructed and independently corroborated from author-committed legacy data.

The five original process RNG states and patient assignments were neither fixed nor logged and are forensically unrecoverable; Foundry seeds 0-4 and checked assignments are replacements, not recovered author seeds.
The paper reports about 61,000 cells in its main table and 11,862 in Appendix G; the pinned v1 CSV contains exactly 54,989 cells.
The paper says 29 markers in the data appendix but refers to 30 in its learned-feature discussion.
The publication-proximal script defaults to two views and 20 epochs even though the headline paper setting uses four views and 100 epochs.
The faithful procedure selects the best epoch on the test set; corrected evaluation requires a validation set and must be reported separately.
